targets.review_note: Base10 is always valid. For bases above cube-root(y), the representation has at most three digits since lower>=10 excludes one digit. Enumerate all two/three decimal-digit representations and solve their linear/quadratic equations using exact integer arithmetic. Check remaining bases descending up to integer cube root, at most10^6. No floating equality checks; adjust root bound exactly.

targets.review_note: Aggregate planets with equal period after rotating by their present time. Periods13,17,19,23 are coprime to all remaining allowed periods<=24, and cannot have multiples in that range; CRT lets their independent maxima coexist. All other periods divide55440, so enumerate their exact joint cycle and add the independent maxima. Handles repeated periods and multi-dataset zero sentinel.
